_comment: The rig: which logical fixture (as M4 numbers them, 0..n-1) is which real light. One patch file per rig. address = DMX start channel (1-512), or null for a preview-only fixture. Default: 8 LPC1818 pars at the venue's addresses 1, 11, ... 71. Edit to match the real lights; set each light's address on its own menu.
